statement: Complete K5-e high-triangle 2,4,2 stabilizer-slice domination theorem. With the three unmarked-edge orbit activities a,b,c, the deletion and marked-endpoint-connected forest polynomials factor as P=bF and xi=bG. After y=b+1 and z=c+1, the distinguished component is exactly y>1, z>sqrt(2/(y^2+1)), and a>r_F^+(y,z), the epigraph above the upper a-root of F. On this epigraph G is an upward quadratic; its roots can neither be born above the F wall nor cross the upper F root. Since G has no real root on the anchor base fibre, G>0 throughout, and therefore xi=bG>0.
closes: proves G215 for the complete three-variable K5-e high-triangle 2,4,2 stabilizer specialization
establishes the exact upper-root epigraph description of its distinguished component
extends the independently audited local domination certificates beyond W4 to a nine-edge 3-connected host

the other K5-e marked-edge orbit and the full triangular-prism triangle-edge component remain open
G201, a minor-adaptive edge-selection theorem, and the global OPG-1757 closure remain open
